label: clean build
args: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON; cmake --build build

label: copy to HoMM3
args: Copy-Item build/BattleLogger.dll 'Z:/Games2/HoMM 3 SOD/BattleLogger.dll' -Force; Write-Host 'Copied to HoMM 3 SOD/BattleLogger.dll'
